title: Analyze the annual average purchase price per Bitcoin by region, computed a
question: Analyze the annual average purchase price per Bitcoin by region, computed as the total dollar amount spent divided by the total quantity purchased each year, excluding the first year's data for each region. Then, for each year, rank the regions based on these average purchase prices, and calculate the annual percentage change in cost for each region compared to the previous year.

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    m.region,
    CAST(substr(t.txn_date, 7, 4) AS INTEGER) AS yr,
    SUM(p.price * t.quantity) AS total_dollar,
    SUM(t.quantity) AS total_qty
  FROM bitcoin_transactions t
  JOIN bitcoin_members m ON t.member_id = m.member_id
  JOIN bitcoin_prices p ON p.ticker = t.ticker AND p.market_date = t.txn_date
  WHERE t.txn_type = 'BUY' AND t.ticker = 'BTC'
  GROUP BY m.region, CAST(substr(t.txn_date, 7, 4) AS INTEGER)
),
first_year AS (
  SELECT region, MIN(yr) AS min_yr
  FROM base
  GROUP BY region
),
avg AS (
  SELECT
    b.region,
    b.yr,
    b.total_dollar / b.total_qty AS avg_price
  FROM base b
  JOIN first_year f ON b.region = f.region
  WHERE b.yr > f.min_yr
)
SELECT
  a.yr,
  a.region,
  a.avg_price,
  RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.yr ORDER BY a.avg_price) AS price_rank,
  (a.avg_price - LAG(a.avg_price) OVER (PARTITION BY a.region ORDER BY a.yr))
    / LAG(a.avg_price) OVER (PARTITION BY a.region ORDER BY a.yr) * 100 AS pct_change
FROM avg a
ORDER BY a.yr, a.avg_price
